s0510: As a designer on the ticketing modernization program (PMB), I worked on the user journeys of 12 interdependent features, alongside several teams each working in their own files, some dating back to 2019.
s0511: At IDFM, the project had been launched with several independent stakeholders before a design team came on board. Project managers and stakeholders had started designing mockups without relying on IDFM's brand guidelines, which did not exist at the time, or on the platform conventions of each technology.
